En tant que Data Performance and Project Manager
, vous jouez un rôle clé dans le renforcement de l’impact de la data au sein de MMD (l’agence Retail Media de Delhaize). Vous faites le lien entre les besoins du business et l’expertise technique, en veillant à ce que les données, les analyses de performance et les solutions innovantes se traduisent en valeur commerciale concrète et contribuent aux ambitions à long terme de MMD.

Dans cette fonction, vous combinez l’analyse de données et le suivi des performances commerciales. Vous contribuez au développement des capacités de reporting et de mesure, identifiez les opportunités d’amélioration des performances commerciales et pilotez des projets liés à la data, depuis la définition des besoins métier jusqu’à leur mise en œuvre.

Voici Un Aperçu De Vos Responsabilités

Vous veillez à la fiabilité et à la pertinence du reporting des performances de nos solutions Retail Media, en coordonnant la collaboration avec les équipes Data & Analytics, en validant les résultats et en traduisant les insights data en recommandations commerciales concrètes.
Vous analysez les résultats de vente et l'inventaire média afin d'identifier des opportunités commerciales et d'augmenter les revenus.
Vous accompagnez les équipes Sales en leur fournissant des analyses data et des recommandations adaptées aux clients. Vous renforcez les propositions commerciales grâce à des analyses, des business cases et des études basées sur les données.
Vous traduisez les besoins métier liés à la data en propositions de projets et pilotez les projets data, de la planification à la mise en oeuvre.
Vous coordonnez les équipes internes et externes et assurez le suivi de l'avancement, des risques, des échéances et des résultats des projets.
Vous analysez les tendances du marché, les audiences et la concurrence afin d'identifier des opportunités stratégiques pour MMD.
Vous explorez de nouvelles technologies, de nouveaux outils et partenariats afin d'optimiser l'utilisation des données et de développer des solutions Retail Media innovantes.
Vous faites le lien entre les équipes business et techniques, alignez les besoins et les priorités et coordonnez la collaboration entre les différentes parties prenantes.
Vous assurez le suivi des performances des nouveaux outils et solutions et traduisez les résultats en insights exploitables pour MMD et ses clients.

Qui êtes-vous ?

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme à orientation analytique, économique, commerciale ou en management, ou vous disposez d'une expérience équivalente.
Vous avez une expérience en analyse de données dans un contexte commercial et comprenez comment les données sont collectées, structurées et exploitées.
Vous avez une expérience dans le secteur des biens de consommation, du retail ou des médias, ou dans un environnement commercial similaire axé sur ls données.
Vous avez une connaissance avancée de Power BI et savez utiliser des rapports et des tableaux de bord pour en extraire des insights pertinents.
Vous avez un excellent sens de l'organisation, savez gérer plusieurs projets simultanément et êtes capable de mobiliser et de coordonner des personnes et des équipes sans responsabilité hiérarchique directe.
Vous comprenez les enjeux commerciaux et êtes capable de les traduire en analyses de données concrètes, en KPI et en insights pertinents.
Vous maîtrisez l'anglais ainsi qu'au moins une des langues nationales belges. Vous avez également une compréhension suffisante de l'autre langue nationale pour collaborer efficacement avec vos collègues et ls différentes parties prenantes.

Où travaillez-vous ?

Siège social à Kobbegem.

Ce que nous offrons

Un emploi et une vie privée richement remplie? Chez Delhaize, c'est possible.
Vous recevrez un salaire attractif et adapté à votre expérience. De plus, vous bénéficiez de divers avantages extralégaux:
voiture de société avec carte carburant/recharge, dans le cadre du budget mobilité fédéral,
téléphone portable plus abonnement,
rémunération nette,
bonus annuel,
chèques-repas,
une assurance groupe étendue et une assurance hospitalisation facultative
une réduction pour le personnel dans le magasin!

Vous aurez également accès à notre salle de sport et à un large choix de cours collectifs.
De plus, chez nous le télétravail coule de source, son application dépend d’une fonction à une autre.
Et qu'en est-il de l'apprentissage constant? Ça va vite chez Delhaize. Grâce aux formations, sur le terrain et via notre catalogue de formations, vous obtenez l'espace nécessaire pour le faire.
Continuer à évoluer? C'est également possible. Demandez à l'un de vos futurs collègues.

La fonction ci-dessus vous intéresse?
Alors postulez immédiatement et découvrez quelles sont vos opportunités chez Delhaize!

A propos de Delhaize

Mieux manger pour mieux vivre. C’est le cœur de notre engagement chez Delhaize. C'est pourquoi nous nous engageons à remplir les assiettes de 5 millions de clients chaque semaine. Plus de 810 magasins offrent aux clients belges et luxembourgeois un large assortiment de plus de 20 000 produits de qualité. Que ce soit lors d’un rapide passage dans un Shop&Go, pour des courses quotidiennes dans un Proxy local ou une offre étendue dans nos AD Delhaize, sans oublier nos services d’e-commerce.

Toute cette chaîne alimentaire commence par notre logistique. Our client, a Global Cards & Payments firm
, is engaged with a leading bank in Kuwait and is seeking to onboard a Technical Program Manager - Cards and Payments
who will serve as a trusted technology-delivery partner for financial institutions and other payments participants in Kuwait.

The role requires to coordinate with customer-facing product and technology initiatives, translate business needs into actionable delivery requirements, and bring together customer, product, technology, and operational stakeholders to achieve reliable outcomes. This role offers end-to-end ownership of small to mid-sized initiatives, exposure to multiple areas of the payments ecosystem, and the opportunity to build deeper expertise in customer technology management and payment-product delivery.

Lead
the end-to-end coordination of small to mid-sized payment-product and technology-delivery initiatives, maintaining clear scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and decision points.

customer business and technical needs into structured delivery requirements, process maps, implementation actions, and acceptance criteria.

customer stakeholders and internal product, technology, operations, implementation, and support teams to deliver integrated solutions that address agreed customer needs.

project performance against agreed success measures, highlighting delivery risks early and presenting practical recovery actions where required.

customer relationships through reliable follow-through, clear communication, candid status reporting, and a consistent focus on customeroutcomes.

Experience supporting technology, implementation, customer delivery, or product-delivery initiatives within payments, cards, banking, financial services, fintech, or another regulated technology environment.

Experience managing small to mid-sized projects or coordinating clearly defined workstreams within larger programmes.

Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capability, including the ability to interpret delivery data and identify emergingrisks or performance gaps.

Comfortable taking ownership, making evidence-based recommendations, and progressing agreed actions in a fast-moving environment.
Collaborative working style that encourages candid communication, shared accountability, knowledge transfer, and respectful challenge.
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business, finance, or a related discipline is preferred.
Project-management or service-management certification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or ITIL, is preferred but not mandatory.

Experience in Customer-facing technology or payment-product delivery
Experience in Project or workstream coordination
Experience in Requirements clarification and process mapping, issue,risk, dependency, and action management.
Experience in Cross-functional stakeholder management and structured analysis and concise delivery reporting.

jobs.title: CRM Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a CRM Project Manager based in the United States.

The CRM Project Manager will lead the successful delivery of CRM platform implementations and managed services for global clients. This role combines client relationship management, project planning, budget oversight, and cross-functional team coordination. You will manage projects of varying complexity, ensuring that deliverables, timelines, resources, and expectations remain aligned. Working closely with technical specialists and client stakeholders, you will guide projects through every stage of the delivery lifecycle, from onboarding and discovery to development and final delivery. You will also contribute to process improvements, project governance, and the continued development of CRM service offerings. This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful client engagements while supporting high-performing, internationally distributed teams.

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

You will oversee project execution from initial delivery handoff through completion, ensuring consistent communication, effective governance, and high-quality outcomes. Your responsibilities will include:

Serve as the primary client contact following the pre-sales handoff, leading engagements, facilitating meetings, and managing stakeholder expectations.
Lead multiple small- to medium-sized projects with low to moderate complexity, or manage a higher-complexity project on a fully allocated basis.
Develop and maintain project plans, track milestones and allocated hours, and oversee budgets and delivery progress.
Communicate project status, risks, issues, and dependencies clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, including architects, developers, consultants, data analysts, and lifecycle strategists, ensuring alignment with project objectives and delivery standards.
Identify discrepancies between discovery requirements and signed Statements of Work (SOWs), assess scope and assumption gaps, and propose structured resolutions, including Change Requests when needed.
Own execution across the five core delivery phases: Onboard, Discover, Design, Develop, and Deliver, ensuring that milestone exit criteria are met.
Manage client escalations effectively, involving senior internal stakeholders when additional support or decisions are required.
Provide actionable feedback to project team members and, where applicable, support their professional development through direct leadership.
Monitor team capacity, resource availability, and cross-functional dependencies to anticipate delivery challenges and mitigate risks.
Maintain standardized project documentation and governance tools, including RAID logs, Decision Trackers, JIRA boards, and shared repositories.
Follow established PMO processes, contribute feedback and recommendations for continuous improvement, and support consistent project management practices.
Communicate service capabilities and value propositions to clients while contributing to practice development, thought leadership, training, and industry events.
Stay informed about project management methodologies, professional development opportunities, and relevant market trends.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines strong project management expertise with experience delivering CRM and enterprise platform solutions. You should be comfortable managing client relationships, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, and taking ownership of complex delivery processes. Key qualifications include:

At least 5 years of relevant project management experience in CRM and enterprise platform implementations or CRM managed services.
Strong organizational, planning, and time-management skills, with excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously or coordinating projects involving several workstreams.
Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
Experience organizing and facilitating structured project kickoffs, discovery workshops, stakeholder meetings, and formal SOW gap reviews.
Ability to oversee small, cross-functional teams, monitor resource capacity, and proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies.
Strong understanding of project lifecycle management, scope alignment, milestone tracking, and delivery governance.
Familiarity with JIRA or comparable project management platforms and the ability to maintain clear, consistent project documentation.
Ability to learn independently and pursue relevant professional certifications, accreditations, and platform credentials.
Flexibility to work hours aligned with the NAMER region, with priority given to Eastern Time (EST).

Additional Qualifications That Are Considered An Advantage

Certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or Salesforce Administrator.
Experience managing vendors and integrating third-party partners into project delivery.
Advanced proficiency in project management tools, including complex JIRA workflows and reporting.
Strong cross-cultural communication skills and experience working with geographically distributed client teams.

Benefits

Annual salary range of $70,000–$85,000 USD.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with full coverage.
Generous paid time off (PTO).
15 company-wide holidays.
401(k) retirement plan with company contributions.
Paid parental leave.
Work-life balance and a strong emphasis on employee well-being.
Career development opportunities in an innovative and evolving industry.
Opportunities to pursue entrepreneurial initiatives and grow professionally within a global network.
An internationally diverse and inclusive workplace, supported by employee resource groups and ongoing diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.

jobs.title: Public Sector Strategy Project Manager
jobs.description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence

About The Role

The California State Controller’s Office (SCO) is currently implementing a large and complex SaaS solution to support the California State Payroll System (CSPS) project. CSPS is a massive project, and the implementation includes both Personnel and Payroll functionality to support the needs of some 300,000 employees across 160 agencies and 21 bargaining units. With an estimated project budget exceeding $1 billion and staffing approaching 200 IT professionals, this highly complex effort is expected to continue for the next several years.

Description

The Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for execution, maintenance and enhancement of the CSPS Project Management Plans.

PMO responsibilities include:

ensuring that formal PM processes are in place and followed across all project workstreams (leadership, functional, technical, and organizational change management)
ensuring documentation is maintained in accordance with policy and procedure
regular periodic reporting on project risks, issues, and overall health, including stakeholder presentations as needed
assisting the CSPS Leadership Team in monitoring system integrator performance
providing analysis and recommendations for improvements to project management processes

The CSPS PMO is currently staffed by four senior project managers who each work directly with a state and system integrator counterpart.

Contract Required Qualifications For The Senior Project Manager Role

Requires a minimum of seven (7) years of broad, extensive and increasingly responsible experience applying PM principles, methods, techniques, and tools. At least four (4) years of that experience must have been as a senior PM of one or more large or complex IT projects.

Possession of (a) a bachelor’s degree, and (b) a valid Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI)

Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis. The PMP certification is required and may not be substituted with additional experience.

Additional Qualifications

The Senior PM role requires proven project management skills in a highly complex and large-scale IT implementation. The successful candidate will need to work well in a dynamic environment, providing exceptional client service with outstanding professionalism. The role requires direct interaction with client and system integrator staff, as well as:

Strong analytical, organizational and core project management skills
Ability to help client personnel to leverage technology to solve business problems
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a commitment to client service and professionalism
Possess conceptual thinking skills, creativity and flexibility
Work well both independently and in a team
Must be self-sufficient and have the ability to self-manage
Experienced and comfortable in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio)
Ability to learn quickly and adapt with other technology applications in day-to-day work

Other

Candidates will need to complete and pass a background check conducted by SCO prior to beginning work
Remote work is allowed, but staff must be based in the continental United States. With advance notice, project staff will occasionally need to travel to Sacramento for project meetings.
Normal working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific time. All staff, regardless of location, are required to perform duties within those hours.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $100,400.00 - $205,300.00 per year.

Our Benefits:

Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow:

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

More about Crowe:

Crowe provides professional services through two separate entities: Crowe LLP delivers audit and attest services, and Crowe Advisory LLC provides tax, advisory, consulting, and other nonattest services.

The Crowe Global network consists of more than 300 independent accounting and advisory services firms in more than 150 countries around the globe, making it one of the largest accounting networks in the world*. As independent members of Crowe Global, Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC serve clients worldwide. (*As of July 2026)

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

Crowe will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Please visit our webpage to see notices of the various state and local Ban-the-Box laws and Fair Chance Ordinances, where applicable.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

If you are interested in applying for employment with Crowe and are in need of an accommodation or require special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please visit our Applicant Assistance and Accommodations page for more information: https://careers.crowe.com/crowe-applicant-assistance-and-accommodation

jobs.title: Project Manager, Architecture
jobs.description:
Type:
Full-time, In-Person in Office
Location:
Flatiron, New York City
Experience:
6+ years in high-end residential architecture

About ELMO STUDIOS

ELMO STUDIOS is a boutique architecture and interior design practice based in New York City. The studio takes a fully integrated approach, treating architecture and interiors as inseparable parts of a single design vision. Rooted in a philosophy of refined minimalism, the work is defined by clarity, precision, and material integrity. At its core, the studio is driven by curiosity and a commitment to innovation — continually rethinking how space is inhabited and experienced. Projects are carried through all phases, from concept to construction, with a focus on thoughtful design and lasting impact.

The Role

The Project Manager will lead two to three projects concurrently, depending on scale and complexity, serving as the sole point of contact across all phases of each project. The role encompasses communication, timelines, deliverables, and coordination from early concept through construction administration.
While ELMO STUDIOS works across residential, retail, hospitality, and select office projects, this position requires substantial prior experience in high-end residential architecture in New York City. A strong design sensibility — across both architecture and interiors — is essential. The role calls for someone who balances leadership with hands-on engagement, contributing meaningfully to design development while managing complex workflows and external coordination.

Key Responsibilities

Manage two to three projects concurrently, depending on scale and complexity
Serve as the sole representative of ELMO STUDIOS across all phases of assigned projects
Direct internal team members and schedules to meet project milestones and deliverables
Lead the development, coordination, and issuance of high-quality construction drawing sets
Run meetings with clients, consultants, general contractors, and sub-consultants
Review and respond to RFIs, submittals, shop drawings, and related construction documentation
Conduct weekly site visits to monitor progress and ensure alignment with the design intent
Maintain project schedules, anticipating risks and coordinating across all parties involved

Qualifications

Minimum six years' experience in high-end residential architecture, including built work overseen in New York City
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture or Interior Design from an accredited university (Master's preferred)
Strong design sensibility across both architecture and interiors, with a clear understanding of design history, precedent, and materials
Advanced technical knowledge of construction methods, MEP systems, and architectural detailing, particularly in residential and hospitality work
Proven ability to develop and manage complete construction drawing sets and documentation
Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the capacity to coordinate large teams and complex deliverables
Confidence representing the studio independently and leading collaboration with consultants and contractors
Proficiency in Rhino, Revit, Adobe Creative Suite, Office 365, and Google Workspace, including the ability to produce presentation-quality renderings in Rhino and Enscape
Self-directed curiosity and initiative, quick to adopt new tools, and inclined to improve the way the studio works day to day
Authorized to work in the U.S.

Site Presence & Mobility

The role requires regular site visits and active participation throughout construction. Candidates must be comfortable navigating active construction sites, including walk-throughs, contractor meetings, and field reviews. The ability to move efficiently across New York City — by subway, rideshare, or otherwise — is essential to supporting site coordination and client meetings in multiple boroughs.
This is a full-time, in-office position based in New York City, with attendance at the studio five days per week.

To Apply

Please complete the application form via the following link
Elmo Studios: Job Application
and upload your résumé and portfolio.
As part of the form, you will be asked to share the names of three architects or designers you admire
, along with a brief note on why their work resonates with you.
Selected candidates may be invited to participate in a multi-stage interview process, including a practical design or visualization exercise.

jobs.title: Senior United States Operations Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
About The Department

The Strategy & Executive Office (SEO) organization is responsible for setting the short, mid, and long-term strategy for Novo Nordisk, Inc and ensures flawless execution of our key priorities. This encompasses long-term strategic planning, empowering and supporting leaders to successfully execute on strategic priorities, as well as driving and delivering high impact enterprise and business unit projects deemed critical to our future success. Furthermore, the Executive Office is responsible for supporting the President of NNI directly to ensure the pull through of priorities to set the direction for the entire organization.

The Position

Responsible for managing defined parts of strategy processes (both development, activation and implementation) of the overall company strategy for US Operations (USO) to drive sustainable growth. You will manage parts of the enterprise level strategy, ensuring together with your leaders that strategic ambition, priorities and enablers are connected and translated throughout the organization. In this role you will support defining USO's future direction, use scenario planning and stress testing to evaluate alternatives and surface trade-offs to help senior leaders make the hard choices that secure a sustainable, high impact future. You will convert strategic priorities into actionable initiatives with clear owners, timelines and success metrics, embed change management to drive adoption and partner with Finance to align investments and track benefits. Acting as the bridge across commercial, medical, access, supply and operations, you will ensure all parts of the value chain come together under one cohesive strategy, working closely with the Director, US Operations Strategy, to integrate strategic shifts into our strategy management processes.

Relationships

Reports to Director, US Operations Strategy. Internal interactions may include Executive Team, Executive Office, USO Lleadership, functional leads, Corporate Strategy and other HQ counterparts to ensure strategic coordination across Novo Nordisk. External relationships may include interactions with various subject matter experts and vendors based on the needs of special projects or implementation of new programs.

Essential Functions

Company level strategy ownership: manage selected parts of the US Operations (USO strategy, maintaining the central strategy repository, governance cadence and alignment between strategic ambition, priorities and organizational enablers

Project Managed workstreams under the strategic roadmap development: create and evolve parts of the 3–5 years strategic roadmap that defines USO’s future direction, identifies enterprise opportunities and aligns mid /long term ambitions with business priorities

Ecosystem insight and risk assessment: monitor the healthcare ecosystem (regulatory, technology, market, competitor) and translate external trends into strategic implications; identify and assess enterprise risks and recommend mitigations

Job Description:

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence

About The Role

The California State Controller’s Office (SCO) is currently implementing a large and complex SaaS solution to support the California State Payroll System (CSPS) project. CSPS is a massive project, and the implementation includes both Personnel and Payroll functionality to support the needs of some 300,000 employees across 160 agencies and 21 bargaining units. With an estimated project budget exceeding $1 billion and staffing approaching 200 IT professionals, this highly complex effort is expected to continue for the next several years.

Description

The Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for execution, maintenance and enhancement of the CSPS Project Management Plans.

PMO responsibilities include:

ensuring that formal PM processes are in place and followed across all project workstreams (leadership, functional, technical, and organizational change management)
ensuring documentation is maintained in accordance with policy and procedure
regular periodic reporting on project risks, issues, and overall health, including stakeholder presentations as needed
assisting the CSPS Leadership Team in monitoring system integrator performance
providing analysis and recommendations for improvements to project management processes

The CSPS PMO is currently staffed by four senior project managers who each work directly with a state and system integrator counterpart.

Contract Required Qualifications For The Senior Project Manager Role

Requires a minimum of seven (7) years of broad, extensive and increasingly responsible experience applying PM principles, methods, techniques, and tools. At least four (4) years of that experience must have been as a senior PM of one or more large or complex IT projects.

Possession of (a) a bachelor’s degree, and (b) a valid Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI)

Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis. The PMP certification is required and may not be substituted with additional experience.

Additional Qualifications

The Senior PM role requires proven project management skills in a highly complex and large-scale IT implementation. The successful candidate will need to work well in a dynamic environment, providing exceptional client service with outstanding professionalism. The role requires direct interaction with client and system integrator staff, as well as:

Strong analytical, organizational and core project management skills
Ability to help client personnel to leverage technology to solve business problems
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a commitment to client service and professionalism
Possess conceptual thinking skills, creativity and flexibility
Work well both independently and in a team
Must be self-sufficient and have the ability to self-manage
Experienced and comfortable in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio)
Ability to learn quickly and adapt with other technology applications in day-to-day work

Other

Candidates will need to complete and pass a background check conducted by SCO prior to beginning work
Remote work is allowed, but staff must be based in the continental United States. With advance notice, project staff will occasionally need to travel to Sacramento for project meetings.
Normal working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific time. All staff, regardless of location, are required to perform duties within those hours.

jobs.description:
Position Title

Senior Business Analyst

Location:

Washington, DC (Hybrid)

Clearance Requirements

Public Trust

Pay Rate

$55.00 - $65 per hour on W2, depending on qualifications and experience

Position Description

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to help Government customers understand operational challenges and turn complex or loosely defined problems into clear requirements. You will lead discovery, investigate how work happens in practice, and develop findings that help customers make informed decisions about process and system improvements.

The Senior Business Analyst independently translates the scope, objectives, and constraints in a statement of work into a practical discovery and requirements-gathering plan. Working with the Project Manager and project team, this role designs and leads interviews and workshops, maps business processes, analyzes findings, and develops validated requirements. The analyst also provides direction and feedback to junior analysts.

Responsibilities

Interpret the statement of work and available background information to define discovery objectives, identify information gaps, and develop a sequenced plan aligned with the engagement scope and deliverables.
Independently select and design the requirements-gathering approach based on the problem, stakeholder groups, and operational context, identifying assumptions or scope questions that require customer clarification.
Design workshop structures, including objectives, participants, agendas, facilitation activities, and expected outputs, to investigate processes and reconcile differing perspectives. Develop tailored interview guides and reusable discovery templates.
Lead interviews and facilitate workshops, asking focused questions to uncover unstated needs, exceptions, workarounds, and differences between documented procedures and actual practice. Adapt the approach as findings emerge.
Map and analyze business processes across teams, documenting decision points, handoffs, responsibilities, dependencies, and bottlenecks.
Research relevant policies, procedures, existing documentation, and available operational evidence. Analyze findings across sources to identify themes, conflicting accounts, underlying causes, and improvement opportunities.
Translate validated findings into clear, specific, and verifiable business and system requirements, distinguishing underlying needs from proposed solutions and maintaining the connection to supporting evidence.
Verify requirements for clarity, consistency, completeness, and evidentiary support. Validate process documentation and requirements with stakeholders to confirm they reflect actual operations, business needs, and intended outcomes.
Present evidence-based findings and recommendations, identifying assumptions and unresolved questions. Review and guide junior analysts' work.
Use approved AI tools to improve the efficiency of research, analysis, and documentation. Independently verify AI-assisted outputs against source evidence, correct errors and unsupported conclusions, and follow applicable customer and company data-handling requirements.
Additional responsibilities include supporting growth and proposal efforts, as well as expanding business within your assigned portfolio.

Required Skills/Education

Preferred Skills and Experience:

Experience supporting Government customers or working in environments where policies and organizational responsibilities shape operations. Experience analyzing processes that involve multiple teams or organizations, and familiarity with process-mapping and requirements-management tools.

Work Experience Requirements

Five or more years of relevant experience in business analysis, requirements development, or business process improvement.
Demonstrated experience independently planning and leading discovery from a statement of work or similarly defined engagement scope, including designing workshops and selecting requirements-gathering methods without step-by-step direction.
Proven ability to analyze ambiguous or conflicting information, develop process maps, and translate operational findings into actionable requirements.
Strong research and analytical skills, including evaluating sources, testing assumptions, and identifying missing evidence.
Clear written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain findings to business and technical audiences.
Sound judgment in working with customers, completing assigned analysis activities, and raising issues that require a decision.
Practical experience using AI tools in analysis and documentation, with the ability to evaluate outputs, verify supporting evidence, and perform the underlying business analysis independently of AI.

Education Requirements

A bachelor's degree in business, information systems, public administration, or a related field is preferred, not required. Candidates without a degree are encouraged to apply if their professional experience demonstrates the required analytical, research, and communication skills and they meet the work experience requirements.

new_jobs.description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence

About The Role

The California State Controller’s Office (SCO) is currently implementing a large and complex SaaS solution to support the California State Payroll System (CSPS) project. CSPS is a massive project, and the implementation includes both Personnel and Payroll functionality to support the needs of some 300,000 employees across 160 agencies and 21 bargaining units. With an estimated project budget exceeding $1 billion and staffing approaching 200 IT professionals, this highly complex effort is expected to continue for the next several years.

Description

The Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for execution, maintenance and enhancement of the CSPS Project Management Plans.

PMO responsibilities include:

ensuring that formal PM processes are in place and followed across all project workstreams (leadership, functional, technical, and organizational change management)
ensuring documentation is maintained in accordance with policy and procedure
regular periodic reporting on project risks, issues, and overall health, including stakeholder presentations as needed
assisting the CSPS Leadership Team in monitoring system integrator performance
providing analysis and recommendations for improvements to project management processes

The CSPS PMO is currently staffed by four senior project managers who each work directly with a state and system integrator counterpart.

Contract Required Qualifications For The Senior Project Manager Role

Requires a minimum of seven (7) years of broad, extensive and increasingly responsible experience applying PM principles, methods, techniques, and tools. At least four (4) years of that experience must have been as a senior PM of one or more large or complex IT projects.

Possession of (a) a bachelor’s degree, and (b) a valid Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI)

Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis. The PMP certification is required and may not be substituted with additional experience.

Additional Qualifications

The Senior PM role requires proven project management skills in a highly complex and large-scale IT implementation. The successful candidate will need to work well in a dynamic environment, providing exceptional client service with outstanding professionalism. The role requires direct interaction with client and system integrator staff, as well as:

Strong analytical, organizational and core project management skills
Ability to help client personnel to leverage technology to solve business problems
Strong verbal and written communication skills with a commitment to client service and professionalism
Possess conceptual thinking skills, creativity and flexibility
Work well both independently and in a team
Must be self-sufficient and have the ability to self-manage
Experienced and comfortable in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio)
Ability to learn quickly and adapt with other technology applications in day-to-day work

Other

Candidates will need to complete and pass a background check conducted by SCO prior to beginning work
Remote work is allowed, but staff must be based in the continental United States. With advance notice, project staff will occasionally need to travel to Sacramento for project meetings.
Normal working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific time. All staff, regardless of location, are required to perform duties within those hours.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $100,400.00 - $205,300.00 per year.

Our Benefits:

Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow:

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

More about Crowe:

Crowe provides professional services through two separate entities: Crowe LLP delivers audit and attest services, and Crowe Advisory LLC provides tax, advisory, consulting, and other nonattest services.

The Crowe Global network consists of more than 300 independent accounting and advisory services firms in more than 150 countries around the globe, making it one of the largest accounting networks in the world*. As independent members of Crowe Global, Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC serve clients worldwide. (*As of July 2026)

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

Crowe will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Please visit our webpage to see notices of the various state and local Ban-the-Box laws and Fair Chance Ordinances, where applicable.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

If you are interested in applying for employment with Crowe and are in need of an accommodation or require special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please visit our Applicant Assistance and Accommodations page for more information: https://careers.crowe.com/crowe-applicant-assistance-and-accommodation

new_jobs.description:
An established technology business specialising in retail ERP solutions is looking for an experienced Senior Technical Project Manager
to oversee project delivery and team management across one of its key product streams.

Working with the PMO, you'll help guide your assigned product stream and oversee multiple projects through to delivery. You'll lead an onshore and offshore team across Project Management, Business Analysis, Development and DevOps, with responsibility for performance management, resource coordination and team development, while maintaining strong client and stakeholder relationships.

Salary:
180 -190k + super

Location:
NSW, 2127

Work arrangement:
Permanent role, hybrid (3 days p/w in office)

Key Responsibilities

Manage multiple projects concurrently, from requirements gathering and planning through to deployment and hypercare.
Oversee project scope, schedules, budgets, resources and delivery risks, ensuring projects meet agreed objectives.
Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team of Project Managers, Business Analysts, Developers and DevOps professionals across onshore and offshore locations.
Manage team performance, including setting performance plans, conducting annual reviews and supporting ongoing professional development.
Provide coaching, mentoring and direction to team members, building capability and encouraging a collaborative, cross-skilled team.
Coordinate internal resources and external stakeholders to manage competing priorities and ensure successful project delivery.
Build strong relationships with customers and senior stakeholders, acting as a key point of contact throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor project progress, manage changing requirements and address delivery challenges as they arise.
Prepare and present project updates, risks and delivery progress to senior management.
Identify opportunities to improve project delivery processes, team performance and ways of working.

About You

At least 5 years' experience managing projects in a technical environment.
Previous experience leading multidisciplinary teams, including Developers, DevOps, Business Analysts and Project Managers, across onshore and offshore locations.
Confident managing people, including performance plans, annual reviews, coaching and development.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build relationships with internal teams, senior stakeholders and external clients.
Resilient, patient and adaptable, with the ability to navigate challenges and keep projects moving when things don't go to plan.
Experience working across Agile and Waterfall environments, with strong knowledge of JIRA and Confluence.
Project Management qualifications such as PMP or PRINCE2, or relevant industry experience.
Experience within automotive retail, Dealer Management Systems (DMS) or ERP environments would be highly regarded.

What's On Offer

The opportunity to take ownership of a key development stream within an established technology business.
A senior leadership position combining project delivery, people management and stakeholder engagement.
Exposure to large-scale technology projects and the evolving automotive retail industry.
Flexible working arrangements, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.
Interstate travel and the opportunity to work closely with customers across Australia and New Zealand.

Sound like you? Apply now!

new_jobs.description:
Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the worldâs most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Shape the future of infrastructure with AECOM.

At AECOM, we’re delivering a better world. From roads and bridges to major transport and infrastructure programs, we’re working with clients, communities and partners to solve some of the world’s most complex challenges.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager/Site Engineer to join our team and play a key role in delivering high-quality civil infrastructure projects across the region.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of projects from planning and mobilisation through to delivery and close-out, working alongside some of the industry’s leading technical specialists and project professionals. You’ll bring strong project management capability, commercial awareness and a collaborative leadership style to deliver outcomes that make a real difference to the communities we serve.

What you’ll do

As a Project Manager, you’ll take a leading role in the successful delivery of infrastructure projects, balancing technical, commercial, safety, quality and stakeholder requirements to achieve outstanding project outcomes.

You’ll:

Lead the planning, coordination and delivery of civil infrastructure projects, ensuring they are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the required quality standards.
Provide strong project leadership across the project lifecycle, from early planning and constructability through to construction, commissioning and close-out.
Work closely with clients, contractors, consultants and internal technical teams to establish clear project objectives and drive successful delivery.

Lead and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, creating an inclusive environment where people can perform at their best.
Identify opportunities to improve project delivery, systems and processes and contribute to the continued growth and success of AECOM’s infrastructure business.

Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who combines strong project management capability with a genuine passion for delivering infrastructure that benefits communities.

A degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, recognised by Engineers Australia.

Experience across project development, construction delivery and contract administration.
Strong understanding of civil construction methodologies, road and bridge design, construction, maintenance and materials.
Experience managing project budgets, programs, resources, risks and commercial outcomes.
Experience working with major contract forms such as AS 2124, AS 4300, D&C, Alliance or similar contracting models is desirable.
Strong understanding of project governance, quality, safety and risk management.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels.
Strong commercial awareness and the confidence to make sound, timely decisions in a complex project environment.
A collaborative approach and the ability to bring multidisciplinary teams together around a common goal.
A commitment to creating a safe, inclusive and high-performing project environment.

RPEQ registration, or the ability to obtain RPEQ, will be highly regarded.

Additional Information

Why AECOM?

You’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the region’s most significant infrastructure projects while being part of a truly global organisation.

At AECOM, you’ll work alongside talented engineers, planners, project managers, designers and technical specialists who are passionate about creating a better future. We bring together diverse perspectives and expertise to solve complex problems and deliver outcomes that matter.

We believe infrastructure is about more than what we build. It’s about connecting people, enabling communities and creating places where people can thrive.

AECOM – where your ideas can make a difference

Apply now and bring your expertise to AECOM.

new_jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Business Process Manager

We Are Hiring 3 Implementation Managers To Drive Our Global Quote-to-Order Transformation. You Will Join a Key Initiative To Standardize Commercial Processes And Digital Solutions Across Our Business. Apply For The Region That Matches Your Profile And Career Aspirations

Europe — Flexible location across European countries
America — Flexible location across American countries
Asia — Flexible location across Asia (excl. China)

Each role is autonomous and high-impact, with direct influence on how our commercial operations work in your region.

About The Role

Join ABB Robotics as an Implementation Manager and drive the implementation and adoption of our global Quote-to-Order process and supporting digital solutions.

The role will work closely with country commercial organizations to understand their current ways of working, introduce the global Quote-to-Order process, identify gaps and local requirements, and support countries through the transition to the target process and tools. The current solution landscape includes CPQ and the commercial Quote-to-Order processes interfacing with SAP S/4HANA
, together with other supporting applications. The scope may evolve as the Quote-to-Order process and application landscape develops. The position is part of the Commercial Excellence – Quote to Order Process
organization and reports to the Quote to Order Process Manager
.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.

What You Will Do

Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.
Act as the primary business process advisor and second-level tool support contact for your region's countries — balancing process discipline with pragmatic tool troubleshooting
Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, including the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.
Act as the primary Quote-to-Order implementation contact for your region’s countries, building trusted relationships with sales organizations and key stakeholders.
Build strong relationships with country Sales organizations and key stakeholders. Understand existing country commercial processes, requirements and ways of working and support countries through the change management process.
Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

What You Bring

3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.
Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.
Experience with commercial processes integrated with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP environments is an advantage.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. You are equally confident with business and technical audiences.
Experience working across multiple countries and in matrix organizations; structured, self-driven and ownership-oriented.
Fluent in English; local or regional language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel frequently within your region, particularly during implementation phases.

The Ideal Candidate

You combine commercial understanding, process orientation and change management expertise. You know how to sit with a country team, understand how they work today, and guide them confidently toward a standardized global process, without losing sight of legitimate local needs. You do not need to be a Process Owner, CPQ specialist or ERP expert, but you must have enough breadth across commercial, process and systems topics to lead implementation to successful adoption.

Overview

We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive technical strategy, infrastructure planning, and cross-functional execution across our LLM inference platform.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end programs spanning GPU capacity planning, inference optimization, model migrations, and cost-per-token efficiency, while building standardized benchmarking frameworks and governance policies to evaluate, select, and scale open-weight models safely across the organization. The scope will evolve as the platform and industry mature, so success requires strong technical judgment, structured execution, and comfort operating in ambiguity.

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

Set a long-term strategy and roadmap for the open-weight LLM inference platform. Base it on business goals, customer needs, barriers to adoption and industry trends, and build it with stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Security and Finance.
Turn business goals into ranked technical problems, such as cost per token, latency, throughput, reliability and model coverage.
Define and run programs for GPU capacity planning, inference optimization, model migrations, high availability and performance.
Build a consistent way to benchmark and evaluate open-weight models, covering serving performance, quality and cost.
Give leadership and teams data-backed recommendations for model selection.
Work with Security, Legal and Compliance on the policies and security requirements that let teams adopt open-weight and OSS models safely.
Partner with and influence engineers, ML engineers and architects to settle trade-offs and keep programs moving.
Own programs end to end, from initiation through forecasting, budgeting and scheduling to delivery, including inference cost models.
Manage complex dependencies across the company and with external partners, such as cloud and GPU providers.

Working knowledge of LLM architecture, inference optimization, serving frameworks and GPU infrastructure economics.
Experience with multi-vendor GPU or inference-provider strategies and AI cost management
Experience with benchmarking and model evaluation methods.

new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Program Manager - Core Team Leader based in the United States.

The Sr. Program Manager - Core Team Leader will lead the execution of multiple strategic product development programs within the medical device industry.

This senior leadership role oversees initiatives across abdominal aortic aneurysm and peripheral vascular product portfolios, ensuring alignment with long-term business objectives and patient needs.

Working closely with Marketing, R&D, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and Commercial teams, you will drive cross-functional collaboration and disciplined program delivery.

You will manage portfolio priorities, budgets, resources, risks, and timelines while ensuring compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements.

As a strategic partner to executive and functional leaders, you will guide critical decisions, resolve complex challenges, and support successful product commercialization.

This is an opportunity to influence innovation, develop future program leaders, and contribute to meaningful advancements in vascular care.

The position is fully remote within the United States.

Accountabilities

Responsibilities

As a senior program leader, you will oversee portfolio strategy, cross-functional execution, and product development governance, ensuring programs deliver measurable business value while maintaining a strong focus on patient outcomes. Your responsibilities will include:

Business and Portfolio Leadership
Facilitate product roadmap development, including program selection, prioritization, value alignment, and portfolio optimization.
Establish and manage strategic plan and annual operating plan budgets, timelines, and milestones.
Partner with Marketing, R&D, Clinical, and Commercial leaders to align portfolio priorities with business strategy and evolving market needs.
Coordinate cross-functional efforts to achieve delivery, revenue, and margin commitments.
Promote effective delivery practices, including Design for Reliability and Manufacturability and Voice of the Customer integration.

Program and Execution Leadership
Build and lead high-performing cross-functional Core Teams across multiple concurrent programs.
Drive disciplined program execution through planning, baseline control, and management of scope, schedules, critical paths, costs, resources, risks, and quality.
Represent program strategy and progress to stakeholders and clinicians, communicating both high-level business objectives and technical details.
Act as the primary escalation point for complex issues and trade-off decisions, coordinating timely reviews, approvals, and change control.
Assess the downstream impact of program changes on verification and validation, regulatory submissions, manufacturing, labeling, training, and post-market commitments.
Lead resource planning with functional teams to ensure programs have the appropriate staffing and capabilities.
Coordinate development outputs and commercialization readiness, including manufacturing, supplier, validation, inspection, training, and quality requirements.
Lead product development activities in accordance with applicable design control and product realization requirements, including development planning, design reviews, inputs and outputs, verification, validation, design transfer, and design changes.
Ensure product and process risks are identified, assessed, controlled, escalated, and reviewed throughout the development lifecycle.
Support benefit-risk assessments, quality issue escalations, investigations, corrective actions, and management review activities.
Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to maintain accurate, complete, and timely development records, including traceability, Design History Files, and other required technical documentation.

Customer and Market Focus
Maintain a strong understanding of global customer needs through collaboration with Marketing, Sales, and external customers.
Keep patient impact and clinical value central to program decisions.
Participate in field activities, regional marketing events, trade shows, and industry seminars to stay informed about customer expectations and market developments.

Talent and Culture Leadership
Mentor and coach Core Team members in partnership with functional leaders, strengthening program management capabilities.
Foster an empowered, collaborative, and decision-oriented culture built on accountability, critical thinking, and continuous improvement.
Contribute to the Innovation Delivery and extended R&D leadership teams, supporting a values-driven approach to organizational leadership.

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines extensive program leadership experience with strong business and financial acumen, cross-functional influence, and an understanding of regulated product development environments. The following qualifications are expected:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
At least 10 years of experience leading cross-functional, cross-departmental programs, including 7 or more years in advanced management and leadership roles.
Demonstrated success managing complex programs with significant business impact.
Proven experience partnering with Marketing and/or Commercial organizations.
Strong background in program management, strategic planning, and executive-level decision-making.
Experience developing and presenting executive-level business cases and financial models.
Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering Management, or a relevant specialized field preferred.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification highly desirable.
Additional certifications or training in Lean Six Sigma, Agile methodologies, or medical device standards such as ISO 13485 are advantageous.
Medical device industry experience, particularly in new product development and commercialization, preferred.
Familiarity with medical device design controls, risk management, verification and validation, design transfer, clinical research, document and record control, CAPA and nonconformity processes, supplier controls, and global quality and regulatory requirements, including ISO 13485 and FDA QMSR, is an advantage.
Experience developing clinician-focused solutions and leading within diverse, global, matrixed organizations is preferred.
Strong strategic thinking and value orientation, with the ability to translate complex business and market dynamics into clear priorities.
Financial and business acumen, including investment decisions, resource allocation, and operational trade-offs.
Ability to influence without direct authority, build alignment across functions, and navigate competing priorities.
Strong program execution discipline, including risk anticipation, issue resolution, and maintaining momentum across complex initiatives.
Sound judgment and decision-making skills in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.
Commitment to innovation, continuous improvement, and thoughtful risk-taking.
Strong customer and market orientation, with the ability to integrate clinical and customer insights into program decisions.
Excellent leadership, coaching, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Adaptability and resilience when managing changing priorities in fast-paced environments.

Benefits

Annual base salary of $199,681–$221,675.
Discretionary bonus.
Equity participation, subject to Board of Directors approval, with a four-year vesting schedule.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) and/or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs).
Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick leave, holidays, and flexible time off for eligible exempt employees.
401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions.
Flexible work arrangements, including remote and hybrid options.
Employee wellness initiatives, mental health resources, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
Employee recognition programs and awards.
Commuter benefits or transportation stipends.
Opportunities for career growth and professional development.
The opportunity to contribute to medical innovation and products that support better patient outcomes.
